hooks.name: Validate Destination Data
hooks.description: Runs the scaffolded destination-data validator after destination dataset or schema changes (Kiro University Lesson 3, Hook C).

action.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru'); python data/scripts/validate.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
